newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northland EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northland EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Tuesday she lowered her earnings estimate for Northland Cranberries Inc to $0.20 a share from $0.25 for fiscal 1997 and to $0.90 a share from $1.10 for fiscal 1998.
-- She cut her fourth quarter 1997 earnings estimate to a loss of $0.04 a share from a profit of $0.01.

-- The 1997 estimate was cut due to expected higher interest expense and administrative costs from the previously announced acquisition of Atoka Cranberries Inc, a Canadian cranberry grower. Wittenburg called the acquisition "a good strategic fit."
-- The fiscal 1998 estimate was cut, Wittenburg said, because Northland is expected to spend marketing dollars to build its brand "sooner rather than later."
-- Her rating on the stock remains hold.
-- Shares of Northland, a cranberry grower and juice processor, were off 7/8 at 13-5/8.
-- "We continue to believe that the long-term story remains intact for Northland; however, we believe that many investors are taking a 'show me' attitude toward Northland," Wittenburg said.
